title: Looking for the Acceptance passage?
body: The well-known passage beginning "And acceptance is the answer to all my problems today…" is from a personal story added in the 3rd edition of the Big Book, which is not in the public domain and is not in our corpus. You can read it at aa.org.

title: Sponsor and sponsorship
body: The public-domain 2nd-edition Big Book in our corpus does not contain the words "sponsor", "sponsee", or "sponsorship". Sponsorship concepts are discussed in later AA literature, including the 12&12 and AA service materials.

title: The Promises
body: The Promises passage ("We are going to know a new freedom…") is now a named source, "The Promises and Step Prayers", drawn from the public-domain 2nd-edition Big Book (pp. 104-105). Search "promises" or open the source from the filter or the Sources page to read it in full.
